name: walk_dog
text: A person walks forward continuously while holding a dog leash in their right hand. Their right hand remains extended steadily in front and slightly to the side at waist height. Their left arm swings naturally and their feet take regular alternating steps. They keep walking without stopping or pulling.

review.notes_zh: 右手持续前伸牵绳、左臂自然摆动、双脚交替前进；右手映射高度约1.00至1.10米，适合挂绳，手指固定放松形态，不含精确握绳。71帧含重复端点，循环约2.33秒，源根前进3.45米并有0.39米横移。首尾同姿势，根全程向前，接缝前向速度1.42至1.45米/秒。已查源完整手部与映射正侧面；只含人，不含狗和牵绳。
